verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes snippets from Speechmatics' pricing page, but they describe features (multilingual model, medical model) and a $100 free-credit offer. None states a per-minute or per-hour rate or itemized add-on prices. Without published unit rates in the evidence, an agent cannot compute a job's cost before submitting it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized
